Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the MAP attached:

- Goal: validate Redwood inference for document redaction and downstream cost targets.
- Success criteria: end-to-end latency < 350ms p95 for sampled flows; cost under $0.003/token on expected batch sizes.
- Next milestone: 2-week eval in a sandbox with access to sample traffic and basic logging.

Action items I included in the attached Mutual Action Plan (MAP):
1) Identify POC owner for integrations testing (Finova) — due 2027-06-25
2) Provide test dataset (Finova) — due 2027-06-28
3) Redwood to provision sandbox + baseline run — target start 2027-06-30

Attachments: "Mutual Action Plan - Finova v1.2.pdf" (MAP) and "Finova-eval-checklist.xlsx".

Would you confirm who at Finova will own item (1) and whether the dates above still look reasonable? If you prefer, I can lock in names/dates on the MAP and we can iterate.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.
